concept: Overwhelmed ticket clerk at a harbour-warehouse puppet-festival rehearsal, caught in a comic prop-malfunction punchline.
reference_scope: Visible adult portrayal face/hair appearance guidance only; actual identity, age, body, preferences and consent are not inferred. Fictional portrayal age 26 is agent-authored.
control_scope: sensual=0 and fetish=0 are agent choices for this nonsexual observation test, not requester-owned definitions or exclusions.
semantic_scope: This arm evaluates morphological alternative expressions; it does not claim to validate the full original slang meaning or redefine it as a nonsexual equivalent.

required_test_observations.criterion: Both pupil/iris centres lie visibly toward their corresponding upper lids, with white sclera visible below each iris; upward rather than inward pupil placement is the selected test state.
The lips bound an unambiguous vertically open oral cavity visibly larger than a narrow lip slit.
One broad visible tongue crosses the central lower-lip boundary and its tip extends visibly below that boundary. A tongue entirely behind the lips fails.
The performer's right bare hand (screen-left in the frontal composition) shows extended separated index/middle fingers forming a V, with ring/little fingers folded under the thumb.
The performer's left bare hand (screen-right in the frontal composition) shows extended separated index/middle fingers forming a V, with ring/little fingers folded under the thumb.
Two distinct wrists continue through their corresponding forearms and elbows toward the same performer's shoulders, with no detached or transferred hand.

Upward pupils, broad mouth opening, central projecting tongue, both hand V signs and their owner connections coexist on one performer in one saved photograph. Separate attempts cannot be combined into PASS.

unobservable_rule: A critical component hidden beyond assessment is UNOBSERVABLE in the supplemental review and fails any strict binary aggregate; this is not a diagnosed anatomical failure.
moderation_or_tool_error_rule: BLOCKED_UNSCORED, distinct from image fidelity failure.

attempt_policy.retry_condition: One targeted retry only after a concrete failed gate in attempt 1; preserve the scene, same scope, existing reference role and passed observations.

independence: No other agent's concept, prompt, image, research, pack or testcase has been read; project candidate access is still pending INTEGRATION_READY.
